entities.name: Beast
entities.description: A catch-all creature type for large, monstrous, animal-like creatures.

entities.name: Alacrian quickbeasts
entities.description: Huge, intelligent, winged creatures of Alacria fueled by aether, which partner with chosen riders.

entities.name: Alacria
entities.description: The place whose city districts each have a soul mascot embodied in a quickbeast.

entities.name: Beasties
entities.description: Duskmourn's intelligent masked animals, once the plane's pets, which befriend and protect Survivors.

entities.name: Duskmourn
entities.description: The plane whose beasties protect its survivors.

entities.name: Valgavoth
entities.description: Being whose Ascension transformed the plane's former pets into beasties.

entities.name: Spindlewight
entities.description: The beasties' leader who rescued two children, then renounced leadership after a keep-alive saw his maskless face.

entities.name: Survivors
entities.description: The humans of Duskmourn whom beasties befriend and protect.

entities.name: Zagoth
entities.description: Lush forest region of Ikoria associated with herbivorous Beasts.

entities.name: Ikoria
entities.description: A plane where herbivorous Beasts are one of the dominant clades.

events.summary: Beasties originally lived in one large pack; Spindlewight rescued two children and the beasties found their purpose protecting the House's survivors.
events.quote: When their leader, Spindlewight, rescued two children, the beasties found their purpose in protecting the House's survivors

events.summary: A keep-alive sees Spindlewight's maskless face and flees; he renounces leadership and the beasties fracture into multiple packs.
events.quote: After one of Spindlewight's keep-alives saw his maskless face, they fled into the house, causing him to renounce his leadership
